name: HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL
build: flutter pub get && flutter test (checks, any platform); flutter build ios (real iOS build, requires Xcode on macOS)
notes: iOS/iPadOS control app with real-time WebSocket sync to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: sign-in, dashboard, manual control with a global STOP, live camera, 3D view, telemetry and an offline copy of the last state that is clearly marked as saved data.
